citations.quote: A reasonable basis is formed through a balance of these resources appropriate for the security or decision being analyzed.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard V.A REQUIRES diligence/independence/thoroughness with a reasonable and adequate basis (calibrated to investment complexity) for any recommendation; V.B requires disclosure of investment process and clear opinion/fact distinction; V.C requires record retention sufficient to support ex-post audit of the V.A reasonable-basis analysis.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard V(A) Diligence and Reasonable Basis + V(B) Communication + V(C) Record Retention
